evals.prompt: A partner edits the AI-generated café name, clicks Accept, and reloads. Explain the smallest OpenDots-inspired review flow and files to inspect.
evals.expected_output: Map OpenDots review card and decision to existing partner flow, save through authorized MDE endpoint, read back persisted value. Acceptance criteria: References PageReviewCard.tsx and page-review-decision.ts; Checks proposal identity, changed draft and receipt readback; Never claims a save happened before persisted confirmation.

evals.prompt: A retry repeats a profile suggestion after a response timeout; an older edit is already stored. Prevent duplicates and stale overwrites.
evals.expected_output: Use existing MDE server action/RPC and idempotency/version checks modeled on OpenDots, not SQLite copied schema. Acceptance criteria: Same-draft retry recovers saved receipt; Modified draft yields conflict; canceled suggestion writes nothing; No second editor store, ownership gate or unsafe approval system.

evals.prompt: The owner rejects an AI-suggested event description. Does the product need a publishing approval gate to handle Ignore?
evals.expected_output: Explain Ignore/Cancel as review interaction with no writes; existing development publishing/booking remains unblocked. Acceptance criteria: Distinguishes optional AI user review from business certification; Requires server-side tenant auth on eventual writes; Reports no false data or saved-action success.
